name: sensor_alignment_contact
description: After localizing a held feature and one or two visible stationary reference surfaces in the SAME recorded observation, compare their robot-base XYZ residual across measured TCP poses. Use before repeating a correction or insertion to check whether each axis became closer/farther and whether low travel accompanied rising opposing force. Supply localization RECORD IDs (not source image IDs); these are produced by localize_target. Tracking is conditional on a rigid grasp and stationary references. The reference centroid is NOT a measured hole center; this tool does not output a motion target or verify insertion.

anchor_step.description: Original RGB-D observation step used by every selected localization.

feature_record.description: Record ID of localize_target for the held object's visible feature.

reference_records.description: Record IDs for one reference feature or two surfaces whose midpoint is useful. Their centroid is only a reference, not automatically a hole center.

compare_steps.description: Later true observation steps in increasing order. Include consecutive pre/post-action observations for command/force diagnosis. Total including anchor <=4.

track_with_tcp.description: Set true only when treating the held feature as rigidly attached to TCP and the references as stationary; estimates remain conditional. False disables later feature-position estimates; motion/force evidence is still computed.
